node.title: Re^3: Using the second word in a line to split a file into multiple files
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Please use tags to format your code and sample input and output.

I have .s in the second word, and that second word always ends with a dot.

Now might be a good time to look at [doc://perlretut], as [jcb] [id://11105019|suggested], or perhaps [doc://perlrequick]. The \w+ will only match [doc://perlrecharclass#Word-characters] (normally [a-zA-Z0-9_] plus Unicode "Word" characters), but not including the dot. Perhaps you want to say "word characters plus dot", i.e. [\w.]+, or simply "any non-whitespace characters", i.e. \S+.
